title: Scope declaration
description: Normative annex to ADEP-WI2-CMP-v0.2 §2. W3-T01, 2026-10-25. AI draft for review. The dialect is JSON Schema draft 2020-12. The object has the seven elements in §2.2 and no eighth element. A time value is a non-empty string. No calendar format is named. The marker open is the ongoing-case value from §2.2.5. That reading stays open item OI-4. Class identifiers are non-empty strings. This fragment does not enumerate a profile's catalog.

workflowProfileReference.description: §2.2.1. The profile identifier, including the profile version.

declaredCollectionScope.description: §2.2.2. The subject and the activity boundaries. A retrospective note required by a profile is part of this string.

expectedEvidenceClasses.description: §2.2.3. The instance list. The list may be empty. Each entry is a class identifier the referenced profile defines.

collectionStartTime.description: §2.2.4. A time value the verifier can read. A non-empty string. Not, by itself, a P-6 anchor.

collectionEndTime.description: §2.2.5. The marker open when the case is ongoing. Otherwise a non-empty string. The element is required on every declaration in this draft.

scopeLimitations.description: §2.2.6. Known limits on collection. Omit the property, or use an empty array, when the producer states no limit. A limitation is not the state excluded.

scopeVersion.description: §2.2.7. The version identifier of this declaration. No ordering scheme is defined. That scheme is open item OI-5.
